test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If a sum of money at simple interest becomes 45 times in 110 years, then in how many years will that sum become 23 times?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount = 45P

Time = 110 years

**Formula used:**

SI = (PRT/100)

Amount = (PRT/100) + P

**Calculation:**

45P = (PR × 11/10) + P

⇒ 44P = (PR × 11/10)

⇒ R = 40%

According to the question,

Amount = 23P

So,

23P = (40PT/100) + P

⇒ 22P = (2PT/5)

⇒ T = 55 years

**∴ The sum will become 23 times is 55 years.**
